spans.s:
ऋजिप्य a. Ved. Going quick,
striving upwards.

Coloured, variegated.
--2 Mixed with.
--3 Polluted,
defiled.
--कः
1 Smoke.
--2 N. of
Indra.
--3 N. of a mountain.

ऋजीष a. Ved. Seizing, driving
away, hastening towards (epithet
of Indra).
--षं
1 A frying-pan.
--2
A hell.
--3 The residue of Soma.
--4
Water (Sāy.).

Hastening
towards, seizing.
--2 Consisting of or
receiving the sediment of Soma.
